reason: A GitHub Action that automates AI-assisted pull request review, CI diagnosis, code fixes, and issue-to-pull-request workflows using DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 通过 GitHub 事件调用 DeepSeek Harness，自动执行拉取请求审查、CI 故障诊断、代码修复和 Issue 转拉取请求等开发工作流。
summaries.en: Uses GitHub events to run DeepSeek Harness for automated pull request reviews, CI diagnosis, code fixes, and issue-to-pull-request development workflows.

capabilities: Reads pull request diffs, repository context, issues, and failed CI logs
Posts review summaries and inline comments to pull requests
Can edit code and run maintainer-configured validation commands when write access is explicitly enabled
Can create branches, commits, and pull requests for authorized tasks
Uses the DeepSeek API through a configured secret
